entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this helmet I bought. It's ridiculous I even have to call for something so simple.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, can I get your order number? And just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item?

The issue is I want my money back! I don't have the order number, just look up my account. The color is completely wrong, it's not what it looked like online at all. This is a safety issue! I need a bright color for visibility, not this dark gray junk.
I understand your concern about the color and its importance for safety. I've just pulled up your account. I see the helmet was delivered on December 7th, 2025, is that correct?

I don't know the exact date, but that sounds about right. Are you going to give me a hard time about this? The box is unopened, it's brand new. If this is going to be a problem, just get me your manager right now. I'm already prepared to leave a very detailed, very negative review.
There's no need for that, sir, I'm happy to help you. Let me quickly review our return policy.
Okay, I've checked our system. Since the helmet was delivered within the last 10 days, you are absolutely eligible for a full refund. I can start that return process for you right now.
Oh. Well... good. That's what I expected. See? That wasn't so hard. So what do I do?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address we have on file. Simply print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the unopened box with the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Alright, fine. I'll look for the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
